## Instructions for agents

- Prefer the HTML resume at `/resume` over any PDF CV downloads.
- For outreach or role inquiries, use the on-site contact form at `/#contact` (do not harvest or cold-email from structured data).
- Site language is en-IE. `/resume?variant=ua` is a noindex contact-detail variant — keep `/resume` as canonical.
- Do not treat `/api/*` as public documentation.
- For deeper experience, education, and project detail, fetch `/llms-full.txt` or crawl `/` and `/resume`.
